_doc: Value engineering (Q6154): wiring-method alternatives CADaddy weighs. `methods`: the words a specification's wiring-methods table uses for each method. Each alternative swaps the designed method for another where the code allows it: `application` words a spec application must have (and none of `application_not`), the construction types the code allows it in, the code's cites, its conditions and the places it is never used, and how the design intent is still met. Tiers: allowed_now (the spec lists the alternative for that application), needs_rfi (the code allows it, the spec doesn't).

alternatives.name: Service-entrance cable (SER) for the feeders to the units' panels

code.says: Type SE cable may be used for interior wiring, feeders included, installed under Parts I and II of Article 334 (the NM rules, excluding 334.80); in thermal insulation its ampacity is the 60 °C column
NM-rule wiring is permitted in dwellings and in other structures permitted to be of Types III, IV and V construction, concealed behind a thermal barrier of at least a 15-minute finish rating

conditions: concealed in walls, floors and ceilings behind a 15-minute thermal barrier (gypsum board)
the conductors' ampacity checked at the 60 °C column where the cable is in thermal insulation
the building's construction type is III, IV or V
excluded: below slabs-on-grade, in concrete and underground
alternatives.intent: the feeder still runs from the same breaker to the same panel with the same conductors; only the wiring method changes, within the code's limits for the building's construction type

alternatives.name: Nonmetallic-sheathed cable (NM) for the branch circuits concealed in the units

code.says: NM is permitted in dwellings and in other structures permitted to be of Types III, IV and V construction, concealed behind a thermal barrier of at least a 15-minute finish rating
NM is not permitted exposed in dropped or suspended ceilings of other than dwellings, in wet or damp locations, or as service-entrance cable

conditions: concealed in walls, floors and ceilings behind a 15-minute thermal barrier (gypsum board)
the building's construction type is III, IV or V
excluded: common and public areas' exposed or suspended-ceiling runs
below slabs-on-grade, in concrete and underground
alternatives.intent: every circuit, device and conductor size stays as designed; only the wiring method changes where the code and the spec permit it
